claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit active-duty-to-OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: The official source resolves the indexed rank omission without inferring from the service number.

identity_evidence: The NARA row with no printed rank or service identifier is visually verified. An exact-name John G. Ackelmire appears in a third-party transcription of 103d Infantry Division headquarters morning reports as an Army officer and division public-relations officer in 1944-1945; postwar institutional notices place a same-named Wabash alumnus in Indianapolis journalism. claims.claim_text: McWilliams’s last documented civilian employer before wartime volunteer and government service was W. & J. Sloane in Beverly Hills.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The experience record dates this private-sector advertising job from March 1 to July 1, 1941, before later volunteer and federal roles.

claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit dates establish it as the last paid private-sector job listed before wartime service affiliations.
claims.match_notes: The later Red Cross and Aircraft Warning Service entries were unpaid volunteer roles; OWI was a federal assignment.
